config.purpose: register the owner-authorized saved-batch 27B rerun before any new final score

recipe.starts_from: Fresh pinned quantized base; the lost step-500 adapter/optimizer are unavailable.

persistence.mode: saved batch, not an interactive draft
persistence.checkpoint_retention: Two rolling checkpoints, plus trainer-preserved best SFT checkpoint where applicable. Post-save file hashes reject torn optimizer/RNG/scheduler saves.
persistence.resume: Run train/qwen38_continue.py with the exact persisted core, adapter, optimizer, scheduler, RNG and early-stopping state. Keep the 800/96 ceilings.

selection.rule: max min(dice percent of Bayes - 80, cards percent of Bayes); SFT wins ties
selection.test_policy: Freeze adapter hash after validation, then evaluate only the selected newest-family candidate once, missing-only on interruption. Keep the other checkpoint validation result; do not inspect an unselected held-out score.
selection.reason_for_serial_inference: Earlier 4B diagnostics demonstrated batch-composition-dependent quotes; serial inference avoids that uncertainty for the new primary experiment.
selection.all_new_test_aggregates: Remain sealed until local and newest-family selections are frozen.

budget_admission: Recheck the official refreshed account quota at/after reset. Reserve room for validation/test and checkpoint recovery; never submit while only the old 81.650655 seconds remain. Use measured stage times for later seed/cards decisions.
followups: Only meaningful train/validation seed or cards-weakness changes after the full saved pipeline is measured, with every trial registered before its outcomes. No filler runs.
runtime_and_vram: Only downloaded runtime.json/config/checkpoint/log files establish actual runtime, devices and memory; planned caps are not measured usage.

verification.dry_run: Extracted persisted training core and executed --dry-run; rewards/export checks passed without CUDA.
